sentences.back: Leo plays soccer with his friends every week.
Sometimes, when the children run fast, they fall and get small injuries.
To help, Leo has a special red box called a first aid kit.
He keeps it in his sports bag.
Inside are clean bandages to stop bleeding, and an ice pack to make bumped knees feel better.
Leo brings this first aid kit to every game so he can help keep his team safe and happy.
